paite: Huan angel nih in nitaklam in Sodom khua aphasuk ua, Sodom khokulh kongkhak ah Lot ana tu hi. Lot in amaute ana mu a, va tuak ding in adingh a, amai a lei si in chibai abuk a,
heading: Sodom Mite Khelhdan
english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

paite: "Ngai un, ka toupate aw, hehpih in na sikha inn ah hong lut phot unla, giak unla, na khete uh sil un. Na thou baih ding ua, na pai nawn na ding uh," achi hi. Huan amau, "Hilou e, kholak ah ka giak zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please turn aside into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n nakpitak in akun a; akiang ah api a, huchi in a-inn ah alutta uhi. Ama'n meh abawlsak a, tanghou silngou soh louh akang a, aneta uhi.
english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

paite: Alup ma un khopi a mite, Sodom khomite, veng teng a mi tengteng, atek-akhang in a-inn ava umkimvel uhi.
english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

paite: Lot kiang ah, "Tuzan a na inn a hong lut mite koi a om uh ahia? Amau ka kithuahpih theihna ding un ka kiang uah hon pikhia in," ahong chi uhi.
english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

paite: Kongkhak bul ah akiang uah Lot ava pawt a, kongkhak akhak hi.
english: Lot went out to them to the door, and shut the door after him.

paite: "Ka unaute aw, hehpih in, hichi tel in gilou dah un.
english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

paite: Ngai un, pasal' kithuahpih ngei nai louh tanu nih ka nei hi. Hon hehpih unla, na kiang uah amaute ka hon pikhe ding a, hoih na sak bang un, atung uah na hih na ding uh. Hiai mite tung ah zaw bangmah hih mahmah kei un. Hiai ding a ka insung a hong lut lah ahi ngal ua," achi hi.
english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

paite: Amau, "Hon hon mai in," achi uhi. Amau mah in, “Hiai mi sop lai hiai a teng ding in ahong pem lut a, vaihawmpa a om maw atup vial. Tu'n amaute tung a hih sang in nang tung ah ka hihse zaw sem ding uh," achi uhi. Lot abohta ua, kongkhak hihse ding in hon naih uhi.
english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now will we deal worse with you, than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and drew near to break the door.

paite: Himahleh mite'n akhut uh agolhkhia ua, akiang uah insung ah Lot akailut ua, kongkhak akhak bikbek uhi.
english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

paite: Kongkhak bul a mite, aneu-alian mit atawsak ua, huchi in kongkhak amuzouta kei uh.
english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

paite: Mite'n Lot kiang ah, "Hiai mite lou hiai ah inkuanpih dang na nei hia? Na makpate, na tapate, na tanute leh khosung a na neih peuhmahte khua a kipan pikhia in.
heading: Lot In Sodom Apawtsan
english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whoever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

paite: TOUPA ma a, akikou husa uh anasat luat tak ziak in hiai khua hihmang ding ka hi uh. Hihmang ding in TOUPA'N hon sawl ahi," achi uhi.
english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”

paite: Lot apaikhia a, atanute kitenpih, amakpate kiang ah ava gen hi. "Thou unla, hiai khua a kipan pawtkhia un, TOUPA'N khua hihmang ding ahi,” achi hi. Himahleh amakpate ngaih in chiamnuih thu gen bang lel ahi.
english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city.” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

paite: Phalvak in angelte'n, "Thou inla, na zi leh hiai a na tanu nih omte pikhia in. Huchi lou in zaw hiai khua gawtna ah na mangkhawm kha ding uh," chi in Lot anohta uhi.
english: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife, and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

paite: Himahleh a-awltat mahmah lai a, TOUPA'N amah ahehpih ziak in, mite'n ama khut leh azi khut leh atanu nihte khutte manbet in apikhia ua, kho polam ah akoihta uhi.
english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

paite: Huan polam a apikhiak khit un, khat in akiang ah, "Na hinna ding in taikhia in; na nunglam nga ke'nla, phaizang himhim ah leng khawl ke'n. Huai tang sang ah suahtak san in, huchi lou in zaw na mangkhawm kha ding hi,” achi hi.
english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

paite: Himahleh Lot in akiang uah, "Ka toupate aw, huai zaw hi kei hen.
english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

paite: Ngai in, na sikha in na mitmuh in deihsakna atang a, ka hinna humbitna ding in zahngaihna thupi na hon musak lai hi. Himahleh huai tang sang ah zaw ka tai thei kei ding, thil hoih lou khat in hon pha in ka si kha ding hi.
english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

paite: Ngai in, hiai khua taina ding in anaipen a, kho neuchik leng ahi. Aw, huai ah, kho neuchik ahi kei a hia! Hon taisak zaw in, huchi in ka hing ding hi," achi hi.
english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

paite: Ama'n, akiang ah, "Ngai in, hiai thil tungtang ah leng ka hon mang, na kho gen ka hihmang dah ding.
english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

paite: Kin inla, huai ah tai in. Huai mun na tun mateng lah bangmah ka hihthei ngal kei a," achi hi. Huaiziak in huai kho min Zoar chih in a-omta hi.
english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar. Zoar means “little.”

paite: Zoar a Lot atun in leitung ah ni asuak khinta hi.
heading: Sodom Leh Gomorrah Hihsiatna
english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

paite: TOUPA'N Sodom leh Gomorrah kho tung ah van a TOUPA kiang a kipan mei leh kaat azusak hi.
english: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

paite: Huai khuate, phaizang tengteng, khua a mite tengteng leh leitung a thilpoute tengteng ahihmang vekta hi.
english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

paite: Himahleh Lot nung ah azi in nunglam a-en a, huchi in chikhuam ahong suakta hi.
english: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

paite: TOUPA ma a adinna mun ah beltak in Abraham ahohtou hi.
english: Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

paite: Sodom leh Gomorrah kholam leh phaizang gam lam tengteng a-en hi. Ngai in, huai gam a meikhu, haltuina meikhu bang mai in akhutou ngoingoi hi.
english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and looked, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in phaizang khopite, Lot tenna mun ngei ahihman lai in, Pathian in Abraham atheigige a, manthatna lak a pan Lot asawlkhia hi.
english: It happened, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

paite: Zoar a kipan Lot apaitou a, tang ah ateng a, atanu nihte leng akiang ah ateng uhi. Zoar ah lah ateng ngam kei a, amah leh atanu nihte kohawm ah atengta uhi.
heading: Moabte Leh Ammonte Kipatna
english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

paite: Huchi in atanu upazaw in anauzaw kiang ah, "I pa a-upata a, leitung tengteng dan bang a hon kithuahpih ding lei ah pasal khat leng a-om nawn kei hi.
english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

paite: Kisa in, i pa uain i dawnsak ding a, huchi a i pa chisuan bei lou a i bawltheihna ding in akiang ah i va lum ding," achi hi.
english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s seed.”

paite: Huai zan in apa uh uain adawnsakta uhi. A-upazaw alut a, apa kiang ah ava lum a; ama'n alup lam ana phawk kei a, athoh lam leng aphawk kei hi.
english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in a-upazaw in anaupangzaw kiang ah, "Ngai in, zan in ka pa kiang ah ka va lum a; tuzan in leng uain i dawnsak nawn ding a; nang va lut inla, huchi a i pa chisuan bei lou a i bawltheihna ding in akiang ah va lum in," achi hi.
english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine again, tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s seed.”

paite: Huai zan in leng apa uh uain adawnsak nawn ua; anaupangzaw athou a, akiang ah ava lumta hi. Ama'n alup lam aphawk kei a, athoh lam leng aphawk kei hi.
english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

paite: Huchibang in Lot tanu nihte'n apa ua pan nau apai tuak uhi.
english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

paite: A-upazaw in tapa anei a, amin Moab asa a, huai mi tulai a Moabte suangpa ahi.
english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

paite: Anaupangzaw in leng tapa anei a, amin Ben-ammi asa a, huai mi tulai a Ammonte suangpa ahi.
english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
